name: Floodslain Creature
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #207: The Resurrection Flood, Floodslain Creature (pg. 84), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=557
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Adventure Path #207: The Resurrection Flood is ORC licensed material.
rules: For an animal or humanoid. Increase its level by 1; AC, attacks, DCs, saves and skills by 1; HP by its starting level. Becomes amphibious and undead: darkvision, void healing, immunities, fire resistance equal to its level, a swim Speed equal to its Speed, Drowning Touch, Floodslain Spawn, Sodden Ground and Vomit Flotsam.
optional: It loses abilities that come from being a living creature, and traits of its life other than human, humanoid and the ancestries (removed here): remove those by hand, and adjust abilities that conflict with its theme.

abilities.name: Floodslain Spawn
abilities.description: A living animal or humanoid killed by {name} rises as a floodslain if its corpse is left in water for 24 hours. The new floodslain isn't under the control of {name}.

abilities.name: Sodden Ground
abilities.description: 20 feet. Water flows endlessly from {name}, making the area around it slippery. The ground in the aura is difficult terrain for all non-floodslain creatures.

abilities.name: Drowning Touch
abilities.description:
When {name} damages a creature with a non-weapon melee attack, the target's lungs begin to fill with water. The target must attempt a DC {statdc:will} Fortitude save. A target affected by Drowning Touch can spend a single action coughing in an attempt to recover, which immediately lets it attempt a new Fortitude save against the effect. A success improves the previous result by 1 step, a critical success improves it by 2, and a critical failure decreases it by 1.
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is slowed 1 for 1 round.
Failure The creature is slowed 2 for 1 round.
Critical Failure The creature is slowed 2 and drowning.

abilities.name: Vomit Flotsam
abilities.description: {Name}'s body is filled with debris from its horrific death, which it spews at its enemies in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area takes {=max(1, level)}d8 bludgeoning damage (DC {statdc:fortitude} basic Reflex save).
